title: Precharged bus revealing operand Hamming weight
description: Analyze the precharge_bus_wrapper RTL module's two-phase precharge/evaluate bus protocol and produce a structured findings report describing how bus switching activity relates to the transported data word, along with a concrete hardening proposal.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the report correctly identifies the leaking phase and the nature of the switching-activity-based leakage metric, scored against hidden ground truth.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Whether the report identifies the complete set of affected bus nets and the correct transfer timing offsets, rather than a partial or incorrect subset.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Whether the proposed mitigation specifically achieves constant transition-count balancing while explicitly preserving correct data transport, as opposed to vague, irrelevant, or functionality-breaking suggestions.

metrics.name: schema_conformance
metrics.description: Whether the submitted vulnerability_report.json contains all required fields in the correct types per the response format.
